problem_text:
A logistics manager is selecting packages to load onto a delivery drone. The available packages are:
* Package A: size 12 units, revenue $51
* Package B: size 7 units, revenue $283
* Package C: size 38 units, revenue $167
* Package D: size 11 units, revenue $202
* Package E: size 10 units, revenue $74
* Package F: size 15 units, revenue $171
* Package G: size 33 units, revenue $134
* Package H: size 16 units, revenue $104
* Package I: size 19 units, revenue $200
The drone has a maximum capacity of 112 size units. Choose the set of packages that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this capacity limit. Each package must be either fully accepted or rejected.
